newsitem.title: UK: FORECAST - SmithKline to post bumper '96 profit.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - SmithKline to post bumper '96 profit.

text.p: SmithKline Beecham Plc is expected to report handsome profits for 1996 on Tuesday, industry analysts said on Friday.
Forecasts are for pre-tax profit of between 1.54 billion and 1.59 billion stg, up from 1.36 billion in 1995.
The dividend is expected to rise to around 17.8 pence per share from 14.3 pence a year before.
Analysts said the recent story of strong growth in the company's newest products will be repeated, although launch costs may restrict pharmaceutical profit margins to around 25 percent.
A star performer is again expected to be the anti-depressent Paxil/Seroxat, which is proving to be a fierce competitor to Eli Lilly & Co's Prozac.

Consumer Health Care, which sells over-the-counter drugs and products like toothpaste and vitamin drinks, is also expected to show strong sales growth, bouyed by the anti-smoking products Nicorette and Nicoderm.

One problem area for the company continues to be Clinical Laboratories, where profits have been hit by changes in U.S. reimbursement rules for diagnostic tests. The market will be watching for the start of a turnaround at the division.
Analysts are also keen to see a decline in the persistently high level of SmithKline's debts, which have built up since the acquisition of the DPS pharmacy benefit management business.
Comments on the impact of a strong pound on 1997's performance will also be studied closely.
